answer: Each identity must tend an amber lantern: the beacon emits an umber pulse each epoch, and the agent must light a unique lantern on the knoll. The first wick costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent wick doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at wick 12 (20.4 M iterations). A lantern audit verifies each flame against the epoch seed; any extinguished wick voids the chain. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full tower cost because each wick binds to the unique identity key—no work sharing possible.
